detail: Sarda Mines Private Limited has sold and transferred its dairy business undertaking to Kalkaji Food Processing Private Limited, as a going concern on a slump sale basis, pursuant to a Business Transfer Agreement. Kochhar & Co advised Sarda Mines on the legal structuring, negotiation and documentation of the transaction. The Firm’s mandate encompassed drafting, reviewing, negotiating and finalising the BTA and ancillary transaction documents, advising on the applicable legal and regulatory aspects of the business transfer, and assisting with the related execution formalities.
